release_notes:
1. 100% Defensive Hook Encapsulation: Sealed all 10 registered storefront and back-office lifecycle hooks (including hookActionCartUpdateQuantityBefore, hookDisplayAfterBodyOpeningTag, hookDisplayBackOfficeTop, hookDisplayBackOfficeHeader, and queuePendingEvent) with top-level \Throwable containment and error logging.
2. Production Readiness Verification: Completed comprehensive 10-point audit verifying zero DOM scraping, authoritative backend data hydration, multi-platform parameter compliance (GA4, Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, Microsoft Ads), and non-blocking sGTM webhooks.
